purpose: Illustrated chapter backgrounds for Elevate; fictional environments, not event photographs

prompts.parchment-atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone wide raster website section backdrop, 2048x1152 landscape, edge-to-edge image.
Primary request: warm ivory parchment atlas with visible fine sepia hand-drawn isometric outlines of an original medieval strategy village around the edges: walls, town hall, archer tower, trees, paths, mountains, and a compass.
Style/medium: fine technical sketch, charming chunky timber-and-stone mobile-strategy village architecture represented as delicate pen linework; old exploration map viewed straight from above, not a photograph of paper on a desk.
Composition/framing: detailed map elements around the perimeter; centre 55% much quieter with very faint paths and texture. Hand-drawn lines distinct enough to remain visible at web background scale. Fill the entire frame.
Color palette and texture: warm ivory, not orange; sepia ink; fine paper fibres, subtle folds, lightly browned edges.
Constraints: no characters, no people, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no UI, no logo, no watermark. This is a background asset, not a website screenshot.
